summary: Added a `navigateTree` mock to the agent-server eviction test fixture, then renamed the `settings-back` data-ui attribute to `tree-back` across a Svelte component and its CSS, and improved an aria-label on the session tree list to include the entry summary. All checks (tsc, svelte-check, prettier, vite build, vitest on both packages) passed.
decisions: Rename `data-ui="settings-back"` to `data-ui="tree-back"` in `SessionTreeScreen.svelte` and the corresponding `[data-ui='settings-back']` selectors in `resize-and-navigation.css`, aligning the attribute name with the tree component it belongs to.
Change the session tree row aria-label from `Select ${kind} entry` to `Select ${kind}: ${summary}` so screen readers announce the entry summary, improving accessibility.
